lines: Yeah... I just got too close.
I saw something interesting. I wanted to see what it was.
B-but you saw how it turned out...
Yeah, I know... but I am curious about one more thing.
Um. Who are you? I didn't know humans could talk.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I just came down here to get some fish.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: You... were not what I was expecting.

lines: Oh- well, since you helped me, I could try to help you...
S-sure thing... Um. Oh, I'm Silas...
